### The All-powerful God
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-may-20-2005-1330485.html
Passage: Jeremiah 32:17
Points:
- Scripture consistently reveals that God is omnipotent and His purposes cannot be thwarted.
- Jeremiah acknowledged the Creator's unlimited strength by declaring that nothing is too hard for Him.
- Believers often mistakenly treat prayer as a desperate last resort after exhausting other options.
- Turning our problems over to the Lord should always be our first reaction, because nothing is beyond His reach.

### There is Nothing Too Hard for God
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/there-is-nothing-too-hard-for-god-1270903.html
Passage: Jeremiah 32:17
Points:
- Jeremiah 32:17 affirms that the Creator of heaven and earth possesses boundless power over all circumstances.
- God is capable of fulfilling every promise, answering prayer, resolving impossible problems, and saving any lost soul.
- Human beings can spiritually hinder the work of God through stubbornness, indifference, and harboring sin.
- Overcoming unbelief is vital because faith serves as the channel through which God pours out His blessings.
